fact.claim: You cannot disable encryption on new Aurora clusters, but you can choose a customer managed key or an AWS managed KMS key instead of server-side encryption when you create the cluster.
fact.question: Can you turn off encryption on a new Aurora cluster, and what can you choose instead of the default?

values.display: You cannot disable encryption on new clusters

qualifiers.condition: applies to new clusters where no encryption configuration is provided

evidence.quote: You cannot disable encryption on new clusters, but can choose customer-managed or AWS-managed KMS keys instead of server side encryption during cluster creation.
evidence.title: Amazon Aurora now supports Server-Side Encryption by default - AWS

fact.note: Changed recently. Same post: existing clusters remain unaffected.
fact.author: mine-27-decisions+changes

votes.reason: The quoted text, read under its headings, states the claim with the same scope, values and conditions.
Current Aurora encryption page (fetched 2026-10-13) still says you cannot turn off encryption; no later item changes it.
